an5.195:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.195:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena pañcamattāni Licchavisatāni Bhagavantaṃ payirupāsanti.
an5.195:1.3: App ekacce Licchavi nīlā honti nīlavaṇṇā nīlavatthā nīlālaṃkārā, app ekacce Licchavī pītā honti pītavaṇṇā pītavatthā pītālaṃkārā, app ekacce Licchavī lohitakā honti lohitakavaṇṇā lohitakavatthā lohitakālaṃkārā, app ekacce Licchavī odātā honti odātavaṇṇā odātavatthā odātālaṃkārā.
an5.195:1.4: Tyassu 'daṃ Bhagavā atirocati vaṇṇena c'eva yasasā ca.
an5.195:2.1: Atha kho Piṅgiyānī brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an5.195:2.2: ‘Paṭibhāti maṃ Bhagavā, paṭibhāti maṃ Sugatā' ti.
an5.195:2.4: Atha kho Piṅgiyānī brāhmaṇo Bhagavato sammukhā sāruppāya gāthāya abhitthavi:
an5.195:4.1: Atha kho te Licchavī pañcahi uttarāsaṅgasatehi Piṅgiyāniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ acchādesuṃ.
an5.195:4.2: Atha kho Piṅgiyānī brāhmaṇo tehi pañcahi uttarāsaṅgasatehi Bhagavantaṃ acchādesi.
an5.195:5.1: Atha kho Bhagavā te Licchavī etad avoca:-- 2.
an5.195:5.2: Pañcannaṃ Licchavī ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
an5.195:5.4: Tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
an5.195:5.5: Tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desetā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
an5.195:5.6: Tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitassa viññātā puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
an5.195:5.7: Tathāgatappaveditassa dhammavinayassa desitassa viññātā dhammānudhammapaṭipanno puggalo dullabho lokasmiṃ.
an5.195:5.9: Imesaṃ kho Licchavī pañcannaṃ ratanānaṃ pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmin
